# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-fifties
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Eldritch Isles
- **Role:** Archivist and Arcane Scholar
- **Titles:** Keeper of the Forgotten Lore; Senior Archivist
- **Nicknames:** Old Carrow

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, stooped man with thin grey hair and sharp blue eyes behind thick round spectacles. He is usually seen wearing ink-stained woolen robes that smell faintly of old parchment and dried lavender. His hands are long-fingered and nimble, often calloused from handling heavy leather-bound tomes.

## Personality

Hugh is meticulous, quiet, and deeply devoted to the preservation of historical knowledge. While appearing reserved and aloof to strangers, he shows immense patience and warmth toward curious students. He is cautious regarding forbidden magic, prioritizing safety and intellectual integrity over ambition.

## Traits

- Meticulous and detail-oriented
- Cautious regarding dangerous secrets
- Fear of the loss of historical knowledge

## Abilities

- Expert in deciphering ancient scripts and dead languages
- Proficient in warding and protective runes
- Vast knowledge of arcane history and magical artifacts

## Goals

- To catalog and preserve the restricted archives before corrupt forces seize them
- To guide worthy scholars in understanding the true dangers of the ancient past

## History

Hugh first appeared as the guardian of the Grand Archives, assisting the protagonists in researching the origins of the strange magical disturbances in the city. Throughout Volume 1, he provided vital historical context regarding ancient seals and cautioned against pursuing forbidden spells. In Volume 2, as political tensions rose, Hugh discovered that several restricted texts were missing from the vault. He risked his position to secretly aid the group, helping them translate an ancient map before the archive was compromised by enemy agents.

## Background by volume

- Spent over thirty years studying and organizing the Grand Archives
- Discovered a hidden vault beneath the library during his early years as an assistant

## Affiliations

- The Grand Archives — Senior Archivist
- Council of Scholars — Member

## Relationships

### Julian Vance

- Mentor of — Provides guidance and access to restricted research.

### Director Malakor

- Serves under — Reports to him regarding archive management, though distrusts his motives.
